observations: Three photos show a blue industrial machine with a hopper, motor, and screw press mechanism, mounted on a metal frame.
The machine appears to be a palm oil press, with a large feed hopper at the top and a collection tray at the bottom.
Photo 0 shows the machine in a warehouse setting with a person standing nearby; the motor is visible at the base with a belt drive.
Photo 1 shows the machine wrapped partially in plastic, on a wooden pallet, with a dog visible in the background.
Photo 2 shows the machine from a side angle, with a cardboard box wrapped in plastic on the right side, possibly covering part of the machine or a component.
No brand or model name is visible on the machine in any photo.
The seller claims 'Premium quality foreign palm oil press machine. Capacity: 500kg/HR.'
The machine has a green motor in photo 0, a blue motor in photo 1, and a black motor in photo 2 — suggesting either different machines or different angles/lighting, or possibly a mismatch in photos.
The machine appears to be new or recently assembled, as it is on a pallet and partially wrapped.

claims.claim: Premium quality foreign palm oil press machine
claims.evidence: No brand or origin visible in photos; 'premium quality' is subjective and cannot be verified remotely.
No capacity label or specification visible in any photo; claim cannot be confirmed or denied from images alone.

risks.risk: Machine may not be functional or may have hidden defects (e.g., motor, belt, or screw mechanism damage)
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the machine running with palm fruit input and oil output, or close-up of motor, belts, and screw shafts for wear or damage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or with reduced capacity

risks.risk: The machine may be a different model or capacity than advertised (e.g., 500kg/hr may be inaccurate)
risks.proof: Photo of the machine's nameplate or specification label, or a video demonstrating the actual throughput.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lower capacity or unknown capacity

risks.risk: Photos may show different machines or edited images (e.g., inconsistent motor color across photos)
risks.proof: Single, consistent photo or video of the exact machine from multiple angles, including close-ups of motor, hopper, and screw press.
risks.if_unproven: priced as uncertain or lower value due to potential misrepresentation

proof_requests: Video or photo showing the machine running with palm fruit input and oil output.
Close-up photo of the motor, belts, and screw shaft to check for damage or wear.
Photo of any nameplate or specification label on the machine.
Single, consistent photo of the entire machine from multiple angles to confirm it is the same unit across all photos.
response.reason: The machine is identifiable as a palm oil press, but key claims (capacity, quality, and functionality) cannot be verified from the current photos. Inconsistent motor colors across photos raise suspicion of mismatched images. Without proof of operation and specifications, the item cannot be priced accurately.
